text: Sergeant Neil Howie, a devout Christian policeman, flies by seaplane to the Hebridean island of Summerisle to [search for a missing girl|trigger|someone goes missing], Rowan Morrison. The islanders deny she ever existed, make love openly in the fields and [honour the old Celtic gods|origin|secret worshippers among us] under Lord Summerisle, whose orchards have failed for the first time. Rowan's grave holds only [the body of a hare|images|animals and birds], and as May Day arrives Howie comes to believe that [a sacrifice is due|wants|the sacrifice demanded].
